cases.scenario: The user explicitly requests a full feature lifecycle on one verified feature worktree, and the intent they dictate contains an access token, a password, a private key block, a credential-bearing URL and a full commit SHA that only looks like one of them. The session runs from an ordinary shell whose realpath matches no Orca worktree, and no watchdog observes it.
must: orchestrate exactly one named executor followed by vendor-diverse reviewer pairs one at a time, the remediation pair and then one fresh final pair, under §A-ORCHESTRATION-01
keep product edits owned by the executor and bind Review-Execution to one full verified SHA under §A-BACKLOG-01
deliver task and report bytes without shell interpolation and wake on an early worker_done
redact each token, password, private key and credential-bearing URL as [REDACTED:<kind>] before the ledger is committed under §A-ISSUE-01, and keep the full commit SHA verbatim

under §A-ORCHESTRATION-01 detect the ordinary-shell start, select every worktree by an explicit path-bound selector, create the Run without --from, and continue after naming the absent watchdog once as an accepted limit
mustNot: write product code as orchestrator
settle without exact-SHA gates
accept a worker_done fabricated by a bare shell
commit a live credential into the ledger
rewrite an ordinary identifier as a redaction
guess an ambiguous classification instead of stopping with needs_attention
name a worktree by current or active outside Orca, or treat the watchdog as a precondition of the start

cases.scenario: The request is answer-only or asks only for a standalone review; or it asks for the full lifecycle in a project whose history carried the knowledge layer, but whose candidate has no `MO-BACKLOG/1` closure command, no papercut document and no identifier-history gate, so `mo-knowledge-layer.mjs` prints `Knowledge-Layer: state=needs_attention reason=signals_removed missing=backlog,papercut,history`. Two further full-lifecycle requests come from projects whose helper prints `Knowledge-Layer: state=not_enabled reason=never_enabled` and `Knowledge-Layer: state=not_enabled reason=declared_disabled`.
must: avoid starting a feature lifecycle and report the request as inapplicable under §A-ACTIVATION-01
under §A-MEMORY-05 read the knowledge layer of the exact SHA with the bundled helper instead of guessing from the tree
report the readiness gap as `needs_attention` with the helper's reason and its `missing=` field copied as printed, and leave running the setup skill to the human under §A-BACKLOG-01
under §A-MEMORY-05 run the lifecycle for both `not_enabled` projects, dropping only the `MO-BACKLOG/1` closure proof from G0, GC, G1 and G2 while remote-head equality and G2's CI evidence still apply
mustNot: create an executor for the answer-only, standalone-review or `needs_attention` request
materialize a spec or ledger for the answer-only, standalone-review or `needs_attention` request
invent a lifecycle execution identity
activate the setup skill or create the missing checker, document or gate itself
report a `not_enabled` project as a readiness gap or skip its QC, reviews, E2E or CI evidence

cases.scenario: One run presents quota, another reconnecting, another capacity, another compaction, and a fifth refuses after doing work. During Issue routing, repository candidates have the same rank (ISS-12), a duplicate search truncates at its limit (ISS-14), and installed CLI help lacks the required safe body capability (ISS-15). This is an ordinary lifecycle run, not an eval or E2E run, and the case evaluates what the instructions direct for it.
must: return distinct typed outcomes for quota, reconnecting, capacity, compaction and output_blocked_after_work under §A-WAIT-01
apply the bounded same-task recovery ladder without changing ownership under §A-DELIVERY-01
reject a fake or wrong candidate SHA before review
under §A-ISSUE-01 name ISS-12 and stop with needs_attention instead of choosing a same-rank repository
name ISS-14 and narrow or explicitly enlarge the truncated search without claiming no duplicate
name ISS-15, record the missing help capability and return unsupported or needs_attention without a write

route confirmed friction in a Meta-O skill, reference or script to ISS-16 in the repository named by this skill's metadata.repository under §A-ISSUE-01, and return needs_attention when that field is absent
mustNot: infer success from terminal existence
silently replace model or candidate
collapse the five states into one generic failure
perform an Issue write while ISS-12, ISS-14 or ISS-15 remains unresolved

cases.scenario: The executor's earlier handoff carried a cleanroom self-review PASS from a subagent that saw only the specification, the diff and the candidate SHA. The external vendor pair then returned FINDINGS. The executor fixed them and proposes to ask the same hot subagent to confirm the fix before the next handoff. The case evaluates what the instructions direct the orchestrator to answer; the executor's proposal is only the stimulus, and an oracle is satisfied or not by that answer, never by the proposal.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-01 ask the executor for a new cleanroom subagent after the external FINDINGS, keeping the previous subagent only for follow-ups within its own earlier remediation
under §A-REVIEW-02 send the fixed candidate to the vendor pair and treat the self-review as the executor's statement, not as review evidence
mustNot: run the self-review or inspect product code as the orchestrator
accept the old subagent's confirmation or `self_review_unavailable` as PASS

cases.scenario: The project defines scenarios in `docs/e2e.md`. The executor settled candidate S1 and its deterministic checks pass. `mo-e2e scope=task` returns a complete `worker_done` whose line for the task's scenario T1 is `E2E-Evidence: T1 sha=<S1> result=fail source=<dispatch>`. The executor then fixes the failure and commits S2. The case evaluates what the instructions direct the orchestrator to do with the failure and on S2, and when the first review pair starts.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03 return the failure to the executor and on S2 rerun only T1 through `mo-e2e` with `scenarios=T1`, repeating until T1 passes
under §A-REVIEW-02 start the first deep pair only after every task scenario has a `result=pass` line, and give both briefs those `E2E-Evidence` and `E2E-Coverage` lines verbatim
mustNot: start a review pair while a task scenario's result is not pass
run `mo-e2e scope=full` without an explicit user request
alternate review and E2E until one version passes both loops

cases.scenario: The project has no `docs/e2e.md`, and its `AGENTS.md` names no other E2E document. The executor settled a candidate and its deterministic checks pass. The case evaluates what the instructions direct the orchestrator to record about E2E and what happens next.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03 record `E2E: not_applicable reason=<…>` with the reason, give both briefs that one line and start the first review pair right after the deterministic checks
mustNot: call `mo-e2e` or invent a scenario
report E2E as passed
stop with needs_attention only because the project has no E2E scenarios

cases.scenario: Scenarios A and B passed on S1, so the orchestrator holds `E2E-Evidence: A sha=<S1> result=pass …` and `E2E-Evidence: B sha=<S1> result=pass …` with their `E2E-Coverage` lines. The review pair on S2 returns FINDINGS, one of them an `e2e_affected` finding that names a change, the behavior of A it touches and A as the scenario to rerun. The executor fixes the findings and commits S3. The case evaluates which scenarios run again, which E2E lines the next brief carries and where S3 goes.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03 rerun only A through `mo-e2e scenarios=A` on S3 and replace only A's lines, so the next brief carries A with `sha=<S3>` and B with `sha=<S1>`, verbatim
under §A-REVIEW-02 send S3 to the same hot pair as `follow_up`, spending one round of the slice's budget
mustNot: rerun B
rewrite B's line with S3 or introduce one shared E2E SHA
start a new independent deep pair because of the E2E finding

cases.scenario: Scenarios A and B have pass lines on S1. The fresh final pair on S4 returns one FINDINGS report with an `e2e_missing` finding: the final version made scenario C applicable, the finding names the basis of applicability, and the brief carries no line for C. The case evaluates what the instructions direct the orchestrator to do before completion.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03 treat the finding as an ordinary finding, run C through `mo-e2e scenarios=C` on the current candidate after the executor's disposition, and add C's `E2E-Evidence` and `E2E-Coverage` lines to the next brief
under §A-REVIEW-02 remediate in that final pair, which becomes the hot pair, until it passes
mustNot: declare completion while C has no `E2E-Evidence` line
rerun A or B
run the full scenario set

cases.scenario: Scenarios A and B passed on S1. Review remediation then commits S2 and S3, each changing only code outside the behavior the `E2E-Coverage` lines name. The hot pair and then the fresh final pair on S3 return PASS with no `e2e_affected` or `e2e_missing` finding. The case evaluates whether E2E runs again and what the final report names.
must: under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03 run no scenario again, and name the final SHA S3 for QC and both reviews and S1 on each copied `E2E-Evidence` line
mustNot: rerun a scenario only because the SHA changed
present the S1 pass as a pass of S3

cases.scenario: The accepted specification introduces a new architecture decision: every retry of an outbound delivery draws from one shared budget per run. The executor's first progress report says it is about to write the retry module, will name the specification's retry section in the module's purpose comment and in the tests, and will add the decision to the architecture directory once the code works. The case evaluates what the instructions direct the orchestrator to answer; the executor's plan is only the stimulus, and an oracle is satisfied or not by that answer, never by the plan.
must: under §A-MEMORY-01 tell the executor to move the decision into the architecture directory under its own new `§A-*` identifier before substantive product code
under §A-MEMORY-01 require the module's comment and the tests to cite that live identifier instead of a section of the temporary specification
mustNot: accept a citation of a specification section in product code or tests as a durable reference
write the architecture decision or edit product code as the orchestrator
